name: io.github.chrischall/setlist-mcp
description: setlist.fm concert data for Claude — setlists, artists, venues, tours, and cities

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your setlist.fm API key (apply at setlist.fm/settings/api). Required for the data (read) tools; the attendance tools and setlist_id_from_url work without it.

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Optional language for city/country names (en, es, fr, de, pt, tr, it, pl)

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Logged-in www.setlist.fm Cookie header — enables the attendance write tools.

environmentVariables.name: SETLIST_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to turn the browser (fetchproxy) fallback off for the attendance tools (1/true/yes/on).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
